prompts.party: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original PC fantasy tactics RPG character concept lineup, used in a playable UI prototype. Create one wide 3:2 illustration showing EXACTLY FOUR DISTINCT full-body companions in four equally spaced vertical columns, feet on same baseline, all fully visible with comfortable spacing. From left to right: (1) Shien, young adult male field surveyor and quartermaster, short dark tousled hair, thoughtful tired face, moss-green travel coat over practical leather, cream scarf, map scroll case and compact sword at belt; (2) Lida, adult woman travelling medic, auburn braid, compassionate resolute face, ivory linen hood resting on shoulders, deep muted teal dress, leather medical satchel, carrying folded bandages; (3) Olun, broad middle-aged male military officer, salt-and-pepper cropped hair and short beard, weathered steel breastplate and pauldrons over oxblood wool, large rectangular shield resting at side and plain sheathed sword, steadfast; (4) Marui, adult female river scout, tan skin, short black hair, russet scarf, dark ochre practical coat, rope coil and boat hook, skeptical expression. Mature storybook fantasy, painterly Japanese tactical RPG illustration with expressive natural faces, grounded costume, 5.5-head proportions, warm brown ink contours, subtle gouache texture, upper-left warm light, muted earthy palette. Each character occupies own quarter with no overlap and no background scene; plain light warm ivory backdrop. No text, no labels, no logos, no borders, no UI. Original identities, do not depict existing game characters. Their clothing silhouettes must remain distinct when small. High quality illustrated character art, not photography, not 3D plastic, not chibi.
prompts.battlefield: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: terrain-only orthographic battle map for original desktop fantasy tactics UI. Create a top-down hand-painted rectangular medieval river crossing map, landscape 11:9 aspect ratio. Camera directly overhead with subtly visible south-facing sides of trees and rocks, NO perspective convergence, no isometric diamond. Entire image is playable terrain laid out as eleven equal columns and nine equal rows but DO NOT DRAW ANY GRID. A muted turquoise narrow river occupies columns 4-5 from row4 down to bottom row9, with a shallow ford across row6; northern area row1-3 is dry grassy bank. A north-south old stone road runs down column7 in upper three rows, reaching an open earthen ferry landing. Small copses at column3 rows2-3, column10 rows3-5, column2 row6, column8 rows6 and8. All other spaces mostly unobstructed grass and earth, especially southwest start area columns1-3 rows7-9. Tiny wooden ferry landing on east bank near center, moored empty boat, weathered boundary stones, reeds, a few rocks near edges. Moss green, ochre earth, slate turquoise water, hand-painted tactile terrain, detailed but not busy. Soft upper-left afternoon light, readable terrain, evocative solemn frontier. No people, no units, no text, no UI, no labels, no drawn grid, no icons, no borders. Must work as background under a square CSS grid.
prompts.campaign: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: illustrated world travel map backdrop for original PC story-driven fantasy tactical RPG prototype. Wide 16:9 hand-painted fantasy frontier map viewed directly from overhead, a winding river and weathered road leading from lower left ferry crossing through lowland hamlet at center-left, old ruined stone bridge at center, wooded hills right-center, mountain pass upper-right and distant coastline. Six subtle landmarks linked by one natural road, no explicit branch tree. A sense of a small party's difficult journey through inhabited land, not a generic treasure map. Aged warm vellum, graphite and brown ink terrain contours, muted moss-green forest canopies, bluegray wash rivers, faded rust roofs, gentle paper grain and weathered edges. Fine crafted cartography with spacious quiet areas for HTML labels and nodes to overlay. No text, no numbers, no labels, no compass text, no UI, no borders, no character portraits. Original landscape, mature restrained fantasy, high-quality painted game environment.
prompts.units: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: tactical map UNIT SPRITE SHEET, for original PC tactical RPG playable prototype. Use reference image ONLY for the identities and costumes of the first THREE companions. Create a wide horizontal sheet with EXACTLY FIVE separate full-body small tactical figures in FIVE equal-width columns, no overlap, each centered in its column on same baseline, all fully within canvas. 1: Shien, short dark tousled hair, moss-green coat, cream scarf, compact sword. 2: Lida auburn braid, ivory cape, teal dress, medical satchel. 3: Olun gray hair/beard steel armor, oxblood cloak, large shield. 4: anonymous enemy scout, face covered by dark brown hood, rusty leather, short spear. 5: anonymous enemy blocker, closed dull iron helmet, rusty red tunic, round wooden shield. ALL figures stand in a 3/4 overhead tactical board viewing angle, facing lower-right, no diamond bases; simplified 3-head tall body proportions and strong silhouette so each reads at 48-64 pixels high. Hand-painted crisp dark brown contour, matte restrained color, warm upper-left lighting, little fine detail. This is a distinct tiny tactical-unit representation, NOT a downscaled full-size character portrait. Use TRUE transparent alpha background; no checkerboard, no matte, no floor, no baked shadows, no faction halos, no labels, no UI, no extra props outside figures. Preserve first three costume identities from reference, while simplifying for small sprite readability.
